verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates across the unresolved tradeoffs. River Arts offers the fullest amenity set and free parking; Downtown Boutique maximizes walkability and rating; Biltmore-Area Lodge offers a lower price, high rating, hot tub, and yoga; West Asheville Inn offers the lowest price, free parking, and a pool.
